nodes.description: Private constant bytes32 guard constant keccak256("guard.bytes32") used as the expected value of the guard variable.
Address of the external library/contract that is the target of the delegatecall in batchLogs; set once in the constructor and never validated afterwards.
bytes32 storage guard initialized to GUARD_VALUE in the constructor and checked with a negated require in batchLogs.
Public mapping from beneficiary address to an array of UnlockSchedule structs storing vesting data.
Constructor taking _gatedLogBatcherLib, storing it into the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable and setting guard to GUARD_VALUE.
Public function taking raw bytes logs, checking the guard and forwarding the calldata to gatedLogBatcherLib via delegatecall, then emitting BatchLogs.
Low-level delegatecall to gatedLogBatcherLib.multiSend(bytes) with attacker-controllable logs payload; executes external code in the storage context of UnifiedLogger.

edges.reason: The constructor parameter _gatedLogBatcherLib is written directly into the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable without any validation, fixing the delegatecall target for all future calls.
The constructor writes the externally supplied library address into the delegatecall target state variable.
The constructor initializes the guard storage variable with the constant GUARD_VALUE, defining the only accepted guard value.
batchLogs unconditionally performs the delegatecall after a single negated require(guard != GUARD_VALUE), so any caller can reach the unsafe external call once the guard differs.
The delegatecall target is taken from the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable, so an unvalidated/compromised library address controls code executed in this contract's context.
The caller-supplied logs bytes are encoded into the delegatecall payload (multiSend(bytes)), giving the caller control over the calldata executed by the external library.
The success flag produced by the delegatecall result is bound to the success local variable.
The returndata of the delegatecall is bound to the data local variable.
The logs parameter is hashed with keccak256 and emitted in the BatchLogs event by batchLogs.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter is only used to initialize the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable and has no independent behaviour, so it normalizes into the constructor function node.
The logs bytes parameter is the payload of batchLogs; it carries no independent semantics beyond the function that forwards it to the delegatecall and the BatchLogs event.
The success local variable only captures the boolean result of the delegatecall and is never checked, so it normalizes into the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
The data local variable only captures the delegatecall returndata and is never used, so it normalizes into the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
